datasheet_identity.title: NTR5103N - Small Signal MOSFET, 60 V, 310 mA, Single, N-Channel, SOT-23

extraction_notes: The job identity is preserved exactly: manufacturer onsemi, family mosfet, and MPN NTR5103NT1G.
The canonical PDF title is NTR5103N; the ordering-information table explicitly lists NTR5103NT1G.

The electrical-characteristics heading states TJ = 25 °C unless otherwise specified. Explicit curve temperatures are retained only where labeled in the figures; curves without a published temperature are marked as such.

Curve points are conservative approximate visual digitizations of the published typical-characteristic plots at visible grid locations. They are not tabulated values and no points were extrapolated beyond the plotted ranges.
The Figure 7 horizontal axis is printed as gate-to-source or drain-to-source voltage; that wording is retained in the curve axis metadata.

The body-diode slot records the published 25 °C maximum of 1.2 V. The same table also publishes typical values of 0.79 V at TJ = 25 °C and 0.7 V at TJ = 85 °C, but the schema provides one body_diode slot.
omission_reason: A typical gate-threshold value is not published. The 85 °C body-diode entry is typical only, while the single body_diode slot records the published 25 °C maximum.
